optionalProperties.remediation: Update README.md:32 and LOCAL_DESKTOP_MISSION.md:60 to the resolved epoch; widen SECURITY.md:62 beyond v0.1.x; leave archived receipts/mission contracts untouched.

findings.summary: README.md:32 (verified at committed bytes) states the desktop workflow 'does not resolve the recorded daemon approval/capability trust-surface blockers or public signing/notarization prerequisites', contradicting the 2026-08-22 architect contract that makes signing/notarization permanent non-claims and the shipped TS-001/TS-002 resolutions. docs/architecture/LOCAL_DESKTOP_MISSION.md:60 still records the Approvals accept-condition as an unlanded blocker, and SECURITY.md:62 scopes the unsigned non-claim to 'v0.1.x' only, leaving the 0.2.0 posture unstated.
findings.title: Living docs still call signing/notarization prerequisites and TS trust-surface blockers unresolved

evidence.excerpt:
# Install predecessor from exact verified bytes.
app = extract(predecessor, install_dir)
evidence.explanation: Comment asserts verification that never happened; the predecessor app binary is launched from those bytes.
evidence.label: unverified predecessor

evidence.explanation: shasum -c validates whatever files the SUMS lists in successor.parent, not the passed successor path.
evidence.label: unbound successor check

locations.role: successor extract unbound to SUMS entry

optionalProperties.remediation: Verify predecessor bytes against a SUMS/expected digest before extract; parse SHA256SUMS and require name+digest matches for the exact asset paths supplied.

findings.summary: scripts/verify_install_contract.py only runs `shasum -c` on a SHA256SUMS beside the successor (:195-202); the predecessor zip is extracted and its binary executed with no hash verification (:213-222, despite the 'exact verified bytes' comment), and nothing binds the successor argument's bytes/name to an entry in the verified SUMS (:228), so a differently-named zip beside a valid SUMS passes. The doc claims the gate proves hash verification before anything else (SOURCE_INSTALL.md:96-104).
findings.title: Install-contract gate never hash-verifies the predecessor and does not bind the successor to a SHA256SUMS entry

evidence.explanation: Path.resolve() dereferences symlinks, so is_symlink() on the result is always False.
evidence.label: resolve before check

optionalProperties.remediation: Check is_symlink()/lstat on the pre-resolution argument path, then resolve for use.

findings.summary: Asset paths are `.resolve()`d at scripts/verify_install_contract.py:162-163 before the `asset.is_symlink()` check at :165, which therefore can never fire; a symlinked asset is silently accepted via its resolved target. Residual risk is TOCTOU-shaped and low, but the documented fail-closed refusal is unenforced.
findings.title: Symlink refusal in the install gate is dead code (resolve() precedes is_symlink())

evidence.explanation: No scan of LaunchAgents/helpers backs these receipt fields.
evidence.label: constants as observations

optionalProperties.remediation: Record an observed (empty) launchd/helper inventory from the isolated home; fail closed when versions are not distinct or soften the doc claim.

findings.summary: The receipt asserts `no_launchd_jobs: True` and `no_privileged_helpers: True` as constants (scripts/verify_install_contract.py:264-265) without inspecting the isolated home, and `versions.distinct` (:274) is recorded but not enforced, so a same-version pair still prints PASS_INSTALL_CONTRACT although SOURCE_INSTALL.md says the gate proves a version identity change.
findings.title: Install-contract receipt hardcodes residual claims and records but never enforces version distinctness

evidence.explanation: git worktree add mutates the parent repository's .git directory and creates a new branch ref.
evidence.label: workspace write

locations.role: git worktree add in workspace repo

optionalProperties.remediation: Qualify the never-writes sentence for authorized mission workspaces and list `nemesis/desktop-*` branches plus worktree registrations (with `git worktree prune` / `git branch -D` removal commands) as deliberate residuals.

findings.summary: SOURCE_INSTALL.md claims the app 'never writes outside its bundle, its local home, and the Keychain item above', but mission execution runs `git worktree add -b nemesis/desktop-<id>` with current_dir at the user-selected workspace (runtime/crates/nemesis-runtime/src/lib.rs:110-114, invoked from desktop/src-tauri/src/mission_runner.rs:767-777), durably writing `.git/worktrees` metadata and a branch ref into that repository — authorized, but outside the enumerated set and absent from the uninstall residual inventory.
findings.title: Residual inventory omits durable writes into the user workspace repository (worktree registration and mission branch)
